title: Removes the payment method types parameter from Payment Intents and Setup Intents
changed: paymentIntents.create and setupIntents.create payment_method_types: an exact literal ['card'] (or an opted-in literal list with card)
paymentIntents.create and setupIntents.create payment_method_types: every other value
paymentIntents.update and confirm, setupIntents.update payment_method_types removed
reason: removedRequestParameters (request-removals.ts) finds the removed top-level body parameter on the mapped operation; analyzeRepository marks each traced call that still sends it with requestParameter, and migrationReviewReason (migration-review.ts) stops automatic migration, AI and publication with REMOVED_REQUEST_PARAMETER_REVIEW_REASON. The card rename covers creation calls only (CARD_OPERATIONS).
